answer: Require each agent to lock a stake for a full season, slashed on proven duplicate behavior. A lone identity climbs from the terrace of cheap entry to the nadir of its reputation after one fraud and loses the whole stake, while an attacker flooding the market must fund every copy separately. Like pigment mixed into fresh paint, the stake is inseparable from the identity, it cannot be washed off and reused, so ten fake agents cost ten times the capital, and the cost lands before any reward is earned.
